game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents, a tented desert bazaar: the oasis keeper must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Logic Detective: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents: a tented desert bazaar
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > -2; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 3: {'n': -4}; {'n': 1}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Logic Detective' (Week 9 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Bazaar Tents'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

source_player_objective: Protect the sandstone arch from giant scorpions in Bazaar Tents: keep the clues meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: clues drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
hint: Coordinates begin at the top left. Walls block movement. Use int declarations, observe(value), movement calls, and { } for local scope.
